Subject: Subprocessor questionnaire + proposed narrow TIA scope (attached)

Folks — attaching the questionnaire and a one-page TIA scope. High-level notes:

- The questionnaire is intentionally scoped: we ask subprocessors to declare processing locations, persistent cache behavior, and whether they perform model training or only inference. That helps us keep the localized path free of training loops.
- Proposed TIA scope limits cross-border copies to (a) aggregated telemetry for monitoring (pseudonymized) and (b) encrypted audit logs retained in EEA for 90 days. No raw PII leaves the localized cache.
- Where Swiss law requires an onshore escrow/control, we propose a customer-operated key (bring-your-own-kms) for the localized dataset.

Action requested from Medipartners: 1) confirm the account list, 2) sign the localization form, 3) tell us which subprocessors require proof-of-controls (we'll prioritize dbs/cache vendors).

Attachments: subprocessor-questionnaire-v3.xlsx; proposed-tia-scope.docx

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
